parameters.description: Airbnb domain to search (affects language and regional results)
parameters.name: airbnb_domain

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of amenity keys (e.g., "wifi,pool,kitchen"). Supports hundreds of amenities including wifi, pool, kitchen, air_conditioning, heating, washer, dryer, parking, pets_allowed, wheelchair_accessible, gym, hot_tub, ev_charger, and many more. Also supports special filters: guest_favorite, instant_book, luxe.
parameters.name: amenities

parameters.description: Geographic bounding box coordinates for map-based search. Format: [[ne_lat,ne_lng],[sw_lat,sw_lng]]. Either q or bounding_box is required.
parameters.name: bounding_box

parameters.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be a future date. Cannot be used together with time_period.
parameters.name: check_in_date

parameters.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be after check-in date. Requires check_in_date to be set.
parameters.name: check_out_date

parameters.description: Currency code for pricing. Defaults to USD on airbnb.com; country-specific domains use their own local currency unless this parameter is set.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: When `true`, returns tax-inclusive search-card pricing. Each property's `price` then carries `total_with_taxes` and itemizes its tax lines in `breakdown`, without any extra per-property call. Applies to airbnb.com, where taxes normally appear only at checkout; other country-specific domains are unaffected (many, like EU domains, already show tax-inclusive totals by default). The nightly prices are the same as the default response; taxes are itemized on top.
parameters.name: include_taxes

parameters.description: Token for pagination to retrieve subsequent pages of results
parameters.name: next_page_token

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of property type keys
parameters.name: property_types

parameters.description: Search query for location (e.g., "Barcelona", "Paris"). Either q or bounding_box is required.
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Flexible trip length for searches without specific dates. Cannot be used together with check_in_date.
parameters.name: time_period

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

get.description:
Search YouTube and get back matching videos, channels, and playlists. Set `engine=youtube` and pass the query in `q`; both are required. Optionally narrow by country (`gl`) and interface language (`hl`), or pass a YouTube filter token in `sp` for pagination and advanced filters such as upload date, duration, or result type. Use this to find video content on a topic, track a channel's recent uploads, or gauge how much video coverage a subject has. Note: this is served through the AIsa mapped path `/apis/v1/youtube/search`; the upstream provider's canonical path is not mounted directly.
